units.rawText: Well, since you came to ask for my forgiveness... I am not a devil, by any means. Tomorrow, you will go to Thailand...

units.rawText: In, in any case, you will be going to Thailand with me! Men, take them away! Make sure they don't escape!

units.rawText: CUT! Good job, well done!

units.rawText: I sincerely apologize for my prior rudeness, Professor...
units.displayText: I sincerely apologize for my prior rudeness, Professor...

spans.text: I sincerely apologize for my prior rudeness, Professor...

units.rawText: The moment Meryl yells "cut", Kimie is already by my side and helping me up.
units.displayText: The moment Meryl yells "cut", Kimie is already by my side and helping me up.

spans.text: The moment Meryl yells "cut", Kimie is already by my side and helping me up.

units.rawText: Whew... It's alright, there's no need to be so stiff.
units.displayText: Whew... It's alright, there's no need to be so stiff.

spans.text: Whew... It's alright, there's no need to be so stiff.

units.rawText: You sounded like a gangster just now, Kimie.
units.displayText: You sounded like a gangster just now, Kimie.

spans.text: You sounded like a gangster just now, Kimie.

units.rawText: I am honored to have earned your praise, Professor.

units.rawText: In order to hone my knowledge of gangland culture, I borrowed movies of gangsters from various countries from Meryl-san for reference.

units.rawText: Pardon me... This Kimie ended up babbling about her own studies...

units.rawText: I will continue improving myself in the new year... And if possible, I would like you to keep witnessing my growth.
